fr_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI propose que l'allocation des juges ad hoc soit définie de la même manière que l'allocation des juges suppléants.
en_html: M. RICCI-BUSATTI proposed that the grants made to judges ad hoc should be fixed in the same way as those made to the deputy-judges.
